text:
Amina: Heads-up — paging cascade during canary deploy 04:12 UTC, ~5 pages in 8m. Filing follow-up and linking postmortem: https://incidents.redwood/11321
Jon: I saw it. Dedupe didn't collapse because alert identity used pod_id which changes on restart.
Priya: Can you paste the alert rule?
Amina: snippet:
```
alert: replica_error_rate_high
expr: sum(rate(replica_errors_total[1m])) by (pod_id) > 20
for: 30s
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/replica-errors
```
Jon: Fixes: 1) normalize dedupe identity to service+deployment (not pod_id), 2) increase eval window to 4m, 3) add exponential backoff suppression: mute after 3 pages in 6m for 10m, double if flaps continue.
Marco: I can own the infra-alerts PR and add unit tests for suppression. ETA today EOD for staging PR.
OpsBot: incident summary: replica_error_rate_high triggered 2026-05-04T04:12:07Z -> pages:5, resolved 2026-05-04T04:22:15Z, link: https://incidents.redwood/11321
Priya: also want observability metrics: pager_backpressure_count and pages_blocked_total so we can show impact. I'll file the ticket and tag @Marco.
Marco: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/infra-alerts/pulls/589 — changes: dedupe labels -> service+deployment, for:4m, suppression/backoff logic, tests. CI green. PTAL @Jon @Amina
Jon: Reviewing now. Minor comment on label naming, otherwise LGTM.
Amina: Plan: merge PR, canary in staging 6h, then gradual prod rollout 10/30/60 tomorrow morning. Owners: Marco implement, Jon review, Amina validate.
Marco: Merged and deployed to staging. Monitoring.
Amina: Staging 3h quiet, no pages. Starting prod rollout.
Marco: Prod 60% at 08:18 UTC, no pages. Rolling to 100% now.
Priya: Observability ticket: https://issues.redwood/obs/4177 — wired pager_backpressure_count and pages_blocked_total, ETA next sprint.
Amina: Action recap: Marco: PR & staging (done), Jon: review (done), Amina: prod validation (ongoing), Priya: obs metrics (ticketed). Will update postmortem with owners/timeline and check telemetry in 7 days. Ping here for regressions. :white_check_mark:
